title: 数据保留
implementation: default retention values documented and enforced by internal/retention DefaultPolicy: durable events 7d, terminal commands 7d, idempotency 24h, stats raw 30d / hourly 180d, snapshots 7d, audit rows 90d
batched cleanup: LIMIT-ed chunks, one immediate transaction per batch, no long write locks (OBS-03)
snapshot safety: the newest (generation, revision) per instance is never swept - pinned by TestSweepRemovesOldSnapshotsButKeepsLatestRevision

disk watermark: cross-platform free-space check (x/sys windows/unix) reported as a named readiness reason and inside the support bundle digest; below-watermark detail points operators at the retention sweep
